Keep the channel visible in segments so the path can be traced tower to tower. Use no screen, log lines, clocks, request IDs, arrows or readable marks. Calm afternoon light, no outage or damaged tower. Exact 1536x1024 landscape.

prompt:
Hand-painted anime fantasy in the established OzarLand Academy reference style: a bright Mediterranean island, clear blue sky with broad white clouds, turquoise sea, sunlit white stone, terracotta roofs, warm timber, brass, parchment and green vines. Match the approved illustrations' warm daylight, gentle painted shadows, inviting clarity, restrained detail and familiar sea horizon; use the Step 4 green accent #2C7A43 modestly. LUMO must match the official approved model sheets exactly: the same androgynous young adult face and adult proportions, curly auburn hair, patterned headband, brass protective goggles raised on the head, cream shirt, navy cape with one small plain white cloud emblem and brass compass brooch, leather satchel, brown trousers and lace-up boots. For Step 4, show the nearly blank map, small compass, exactly two route pins, the small reading book, and one small field notebook; no Step 0 apron or tool roll, and no full-size lantern. Any lantern remains an ordinary, practical small brass object, never magical. LUMO is patient, careful and concentrated, never alarmed or authoritarian; observe evidence before acting and know when to stop. Ren, Linh and Safa, when present, must match their approved character sheets and signature objects exactly. Linh carries the long brass telescope; Safa carries the removable metal plate; Ren carries the observation notebook and a plain weather pennant. All people are adults with varied age, gender, origin, body shape and ability. No text, letters, numerals, pseudo-writing, readable commands, labels, signage, watermarks, risk labels, product logos or known characters. The only allowed cloud motif is the small plain white emblem on LUMO's cape and discreet navy pennants.

No OpenStack, Kolla-Ansible, Ansible, Git, Nova, Neutron, Ceph, Linux, vendor, cloud-provider or other real-world logos or branded product marks.

Do not paint risk levels, severity labels, green/red risk coding, check marks, warning icons or a safety status. Never use color alone to distinguish observing from acting; use hand position, object shape and calm practical lighting.

Do not change LUMO's approved face, adult proportions, auburn curls, patterned headband, raised brass goggles, cream shirt, navy cape and single plain white cloud, brass compass brooch, leather satchel, brown trousers, lace-up boots or Step 4 equipment. No Step 0 apron/tool roll, no Step 5 full-size lantern and no Step 6 belt key.

Do not redesign Ren, Linh or Safa; use their approved character sheets and signature objects exactly. Linh's signature object is the long brass telescope; Safa's is a removable metal plate; Ren's are an observation notebook and plain weather pennant. No substitution with another character.
No catastrophe, fire, explosion, collapsed bridge, falling person, panic, threatening storm, frightening imagery, magical lantern, supernatural glow or personified failure.

Do not imply that an illustration proves a diagnosis, command behavior, safe recovery, successful migration or a specific system state; technical procedures and their valid conditions belong in the page text.

alt: Ren et LUMO observent la brume légère se lever sur un pont et dégagent progressivement le passage.
teaching_message: Après un incident, confirmer l’état des services, restaurer prudemment les conditions nécessaires et rouvrir le provisionnement par étapes.
scene: At the bridge watch post, show a thin gentle sea mist lifting to reveal a clear, intact walkway. Ren and LUMO stand together reviewing their blank observation notebooks and move one small plain barrier aside to reopen only the first section of the path. The rest of the bridge remains visible for later checks. Use a practical closed lantern lighting the notes, with calm faces and no celebration or urgency. No broken infrastructure, storm, flames, flashing lights or disaster imagery. Exact 1536x1024 landscape.
limit: La brume qui se lève suggère une reprise progressive ; elle ne garantit pas la restauration du quorum, d’une API ou du provisionnement.
